task_text: Spring gate switchyard: A low-friction puck slides inside a U-shaped pen of bouncy rails that is open toward the right arm, and a spring-loaded swinging gate stands inside the pen. The left Panda has a bare gripper. It must take hold of the gate with both fingers and swing it open one way. The right Panda's paddle must then hit the puck so that it travels deep into the pen. While the puck runs round, the left hand, still gripping, must swing the gate the other way: at the moment the puck hits the upper (+y) rail, the gate must be at that opposite angle. The right paddle then intercepts the puck. Finally the puck must cross a goal line in front of a backstop on the right arm's side while the gate is still deflected well away from its rest position and the paddle is not touching the puck. Phases, in order: left_gate_open: Two things hold at the same moment. Both fingers of panda-0's gripper (the left finger and the right finger, each counting together with its pad) are in contact with the gate's swinging part (leaf or handle). And the gate angle q exceeds 0.5 rad. q is 0 at the spring's rest orientation and positive when the free end swings toward +x (counter-clockwise seen from above).; right_loop_shot: The puck touches the right paddle at some moment during this phase; touches before this phase do not count. After that, the puck's centre is at world x < -0.05 while the puck does not touch the right paddle.; gate_reconfiguration: At one and the same moment, three things hold. Both left fingers touch the gate's swinging part. The gate angle q is below -0.35 rad. And the puck is in contact with the upper rail (the rail on the +y side of the pen).; return_interception: The puck touches the right paddle.; final_gate_shot: The puck's centre crosses x = 0.43 moving in +x, with |y - 0.15| < 0.055 m. Moving in +x means x was <= 0.43 on the previous physics step and is > 0.43 now. At that moment the puck must not touch the right paddle, and the gate must be deflected by more than 0.3 rad either way (|q| > 0.3); no grip is required. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Goal line for the puck's centre: x = 0.43, crossed in +x with |y - 0.15| < 0.055 m. It. Loop line: the puck's centre must get to x < -0.05. Gate angle thresholds: q > 0.5 rad, q < -0.35 rad and |q| > 0.3 rad.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 35 s of simulated time, 3500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
